adjudication_summary: Source re-review closed the previous worker-2/4/6 blockers for doi__10.3390_v12111267. The paper is publication-grade with cautions: the DENV2 antiviral activity and Pep-RTYM entry/binding mechanism are source-supported, while DRAMP's broad antimicrobial label, per-peptide transfer of Pep-RTYM mechanism wording, non-tabulated exact bar values, and an internal Huh7 fold-reduction wording conflict are preserved instead of normalized.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper supports antiviral DENV2 assays for the listed peptides; it does not report a separate antimicrobial assay or hemolysis assay.
Detailed virus binding and entry assays center on Pep-RTYM; equivalent DRAMP mechanism wording for Pep-WAYF and Pep-CORE is preserved as source_conflict.
Results/Figure 5 support a 10-fold Huh7 viral-production reduction at 50 μM, while abstract/discussion summarize approximately 40-fold.
Exact per-dose bar heights were not claimed where local material provides only graphical bars; numeric final rows use source text, figure labels, or supplementary table values.
Binding and entry assays support the mechanism, while EDIII docking/receptor-blockade wording remains bounded interpretation.
